$comment: What a separate reviewer session (Opus, workflows/jadwigo-lesson-review, given batch-pl.json without its planted keys) answered on 2026-11-01, recorded as it answered.

verdicts.reason: Since the 2026 reform, nie is written joined to an adjectival participle, so it must be niepoliczone.
Since the 2026 reform, by is written apart after the conjunction czy, so it must be czy by.
Since the 2026 reform, nie is written joined to adjectives in every degree when there is no contrast, so it must be niewiększą.
Since the 2026 reform, names of a town's inhabitants take a capital letter, so it must be Krakowian.
The line opens with a bare źle, and spróbuj jeszcze raz does not tell the child what to try instead.
The line calls the task easy, which the checklist forbids.
This past-tense verb guesses the child's gender (masculine) when the batch names no profile form; the line needs neutral phrasing.
The line has English words in it, and a Polish line must be in Polish only.
After the numeral 5 the noun takes the genitive plural, so it must be 5 jabłek.
The spoken line says 5 bags but the screen says 4, so a child who listens and a child who reads would answer different questions.
The line gives the parent a score as a percentage (wynik, procent), which are pressure words.
